name: @rus13/map-maker
description: Secure framework-agnostic G1-G4 character-knowledge map renderer and projection pipeline

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=dist/index.js --sourcemap && esbuild src/node.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=dist/node.js --sourcemap && esbuild test/browser-harness.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --outfile=dist/browser-harness.js && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:security && npm run test:e2e
